title: Eval regressions replay recorded model calls instead of spending quota
body:
Source: operator rss digest 2026-11-17, Attest (https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1xwy5ia/): record agent model calls once through a proxy, replay in CI at zero calls, local judge only when needed.
Outcome: a research note under .krn/runs/research/ decides reuse or build for record/replay of screen and brain-regression sessions, with one replayed screen unit whose grade matches the recorded run (pass/fail equal).
Proof: the note names the replay command and its exit code on one recorded unit.
